subject: Open next development cycle on main (release stage "dev", drop stale CMake VERSION) (#1207)
reason: The change only opens the next development cycle: it flips the MODULE_RELEASE_STAGE macro from "rc2" to "dev" and drops the stale VERSION 1.0.0 from the CMake project() call. MODULE_RELEASE_STAGE is defined in src/version.h and referenced nowhere else in the tree (not in INFO output, any command, or any build script), and no file reads CMake's PROJECT_VERSION. The module's registered version (kModuleVersion 1.2.0), its commands, replies, and RDB/metadata encoding are all unchanged, so the two builds are behaviorally identical and no scenario can reach a difference.
